question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e. **'Blocks'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** most appropriate** option to fill in blank number 4 is**: blocks**
 
• In this context, **"blocks"** means to prevent something from passing through.
 
• The ozone layer blocks, or filters,
